work.title: Install the intent-reality coding constitution and conformance foundation
authority: Direct user instruction: implement the governing philosophy across workspaces and builds

intent.productGoal: Make HiveForge work guided by a durable intent-to-reality constitution rather than isolated coding conventions.
intent.capability: Every future session loads the cross-workspace policy, while this repository records project application rules and structured conformance evidence.
architecturalIntent: Global policy is loaded through the harness-supported user-global AGENTS.md mechanism.
Workspace policy refines the global policy without weakening it.
Substantial work has a machine-readable record for intent, observed execution, conformance, divergences, and learning.
invariants: Redwood must surface unreconciled differences and never silently force financial populations to balance.
Observed runtime behaviour must not silently rewrite goals, authority boundaries, security boundaries, or critical invariants.
acceptanceEvidence: Harness session injection confirms ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md was loaded.
Repository AGENTS.md is loaded for the Project Redwood workspace.
The JSON Schema parses and the rollout conformance record validates against its required contract.

decisions.decision: Use the documented user-global AGENTS.md seam for immediate cross-workspace policy distribution.
decisions.rationale: The installed dsh-agent-instructions package loads this file at the first eligible session step for every workspace.

decisions.decision: Keep the canonical charter, concise workspace rules, schema, template, divergence register, and ADR location in version control.
decisions.rationale: Durable, inspectable repository artifacts preserve architectural memory and make conformance review reproducible.

observedBehaviour: The running HiveForge session emitted an additional-instructions event for ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md after it was created.
The current workspace emitted its root AGENTS.md instructions after creation.
The installed instruction loader documentation specifies that ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md is the user-global instruction source.

evidence.reference: Current HiveForge session system-reminder after global AGENTS.md creation
evidence.result: The constitution was injected for the running session.
Repository-level constitutional and conformance artifacts were created.
The local constitutional bundle is registered in the Web profile and composes the hiveforge-constitution host row.
The bundle registers the hiveforge:constitution system-prompt section at order -90 with the required policy identifier and operating loop.

evidence.reference: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process filtered for dsh/HiveForge on 2026-09-24
evidence.result: The active dsh web process was created on 2026-09-15, before constitutional profile installation; a host restart is required for activation.
The rollout record validated against the dependency-free conformance contract.

divergences.expected: The constitution is active as a non-shadowed system-prompt section in the running web host and observed in a newly started session.
divergences.observed: The Web profile now composes the local constitutional bundle, but the active dsh web process began on 2026-09-15 while the policy was installed on 2026-09-24. It cannot load the new profile until the existing host restarts and a fresh session produces runtime prompt evidence.

learning.recurringPattern: A prompt-only policy has no enforceable conformance gate and can be displaced by higher-priority prompt layers.
learning.improvementProposal: Add a versioned harness-owned constitutional policy provider at the developer-policy layer and emit structured intent/execution/conformance events from the agent lifecycle.
